fact: The chamber is vast and contains a great rocky mesa at its center.
source_quote: The chamber that greeted them was vast and breathtaking... and shafts of pale white light fell upon a great rocky mesa at the cavern's center.
subject: Obelisk Chamber

fact: Crude ramps wind upward to the mesa's topmost tiers, which are connected by a sturdy bridge.
source_quote: Crude ramps wound upward to the mesa's topmost tiers, which were connected by a sturdy bridge.
subject: Obelisk Chamber

fact: The chamber is illuminated by pulsing faerzress energy and the soft glow of bioluminescent fungi.
source_quote: Faerzress energy pulsed through the air alongside the soft glow of bioluminescent fungi
subject: Obelisk Chamber

fact: The dragon egg sits atop one of the mesa's tiers.
source_quote: Atop one tier sat the dragon egg
subject: dragon egg

fact: A fifty-foot-tall obelisk of smooth black metal looms atop the other tier of the mesa.
source_quote: atop the other loomed a fifty-foot-tall obelisk of smooth black metal
subject: obelisk

fact: The obelisk's surface is marred by imperfections as though pieces had been chipped away over time.
source_quote: its surface marred by only a handful of imperfections, as though pieces of it had been chipped away over time.
subject: obelisk

fact: Plinki is a female derro standing beside the obelisk.
source_quote: Beside the obelisk stood a female derro named Plinki
subject: Plinki

fact: Plinki stroked the obelisk's surface with reverent intensity, scribbling notes and paying no attention to the armed group entering her chamber.
source_quote: stroking its surface with the reverent intensity of a scientist on the edge of a great discovery... scribbling notes in a small book and paying no attention whatsoever to the armed group that had just walked into her chamber.
subject: Plinki observing obelisk

fact: Plinki has a crowd of minions, some of whom are possibly invisible or hidden.
source_quote: She had a crowd of minions, some possibly invisible or hidden.
subject: Plinki

fact: The DM pointed out that the party could destroy the egg and report that to Themberchaud instead of retrieving it.
source_quote: The DM pointed out that the party didn't strictly need the egg; they could destroy it and report that to Themberchaud.
subject: DM suggestion regarding egg

fact: Themberchaud is mentioned as a party who could be reported to regarding the egg's status.
source_quote: they could destroy it and report that to Themberchaud.
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Gyrgum strode forward and announced himself as a cleric of the dragon god Bahamut come to worship at the egg.
source_quote: Gyrgum, drawn irresistibly toward the egg by his devotion to Bahamut, strode boldly forward and announced himself as a cleric of the dragon god come to worship at the egg.
subject: Gyrgum bluff

fact: Gyrgum is a cleric of Bahamut.
source_quote: announced himself as a cleric of the dragon god come to worship at the egg... Gyrgum, drawn irresistibly toward the egg by his devotion to Bahamut
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Plinki declared that Demogorgon sent Gyrgum to acknowledge the greatness of her achievement.
source_quote: she declared that Demogorgon himself had sent this holy man to acknowledge the greatness of her achievement
subject: Plinki's reaction to bluff

fact: Plinki scrambled down from the mesa to greet Gyrgum.
source_quote: she scrambled down from the mesa to greet him.
subject: Plinki greets Gyrgum

fact: Demogorgon is the entity Plinki believes sent Gyrgum.
source_quote: she declared that Demogorgon himself had sent this holy man
subject: Demogorgon

fact: Plinki led Gyrgum toward the egg and eagerly explained her work.
source_quote: Plinki eagerly explained her work as she led Gyrgum toward the egg.
subject: Plinki explains work

fact: The dragon egg was stolen from the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: The egg had been stolen from the Keepers of the Flame, she said
subject: Keepers of the Flame

fact: Plinki has spent untold hours using the obelisk's power to infuse the egg with demonic energy in honor of Demogorgon.
source_quote: she had spent untold hours using the obelisk's power to infuse it with demonic energy in honor of Demogorgon.
subject: Egg infusion

fact: Plinki showed Gyrgum intricate incantations she had inscribed across the egg's surface.
source_quote: She showed him the intricate incantations she had inscribed across the egg's surface
subject: Incantations inscribed

fact: Daz rolled a natural 20 on Arcana and read the egg's etchings.
source_quote: Earlier, Daz had rolled a natural 20 on Arcana and read the egg's etchings
subject: Daz Arcana check

fact: The egg's etchings indicate it will hatch a two-headed dragon, likely possessed by some demonic power.
source_quote: it would hatch a two-headed dragon, likely possessed by some demonic power.
subject: dragon egg

fact: Thorin previously mistook the egg's etchings for festival decorations.
source_quote: Thorin had taken the same etchings for festival decorations.
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum cast Bless on his companions.
source_quote: Gyrgum casts Bless on his companions "in my magnanimity."
subject: Gyrgum casts Bless

fact: Plinki dismissed Gyrgum's companions as "not important."
source_quote: Plinki dismisses them as "not important."
subject: Plinki dismisses party

fact: The events take place in session 019.05.
source_quote: ### The Obelisk Chamber 019.05
subject: session reference
